analysis: Revenue was $959.6M in H1 2026, up 23% year over year.

Gross margin was 51.8%, up 5.6 points from H1 2025. Operating profit was $143.2M, a 14.9% margin (down 3.4 points year over year). Of the extra revenue versus H1 2025, 0% reached operating profit, below the 18% margin then. Operating expenses grew 63% against revenue growth of 23%. The fastest-growing cost line was SG&A (+89%). Net earnings were $48.4M. The effective tax rate was 28.4%.

Operating cash flow was $174.4M (up 154% year over year), 360% of net earnings. Non-cash charges added back $103.6M of depreciation and amortization and $102.1M of share-based compensation. Working capital and other items used $79.7M. Capital expenditures of $22.3M left free cash flow of $152.1M.

cite.text: Arxis, Inc. · S-1 filed Oct 13, 2026 · Fiscal year ended Dec 31, 2024

analysis: Revenue was $743.0M in FY 2024, up 75% year over year.

Gross margin was 44.6%, down 1.1 points from FY 2023. Operating profit was $102.6M, a 13.8% margin (up 1.0 points year over year). Of the extra revenue versus FY 2023, 15% reached operating profit, above the 13% margin then. Operating expenses grew 64% against revenue growth of 75%. The fastest-growing cost line was SG&A (+77%). The year ended with a net loss of $55.5M. Net interest and other expense of $155.6M was the main reason.

Operating cash flow was $70.9M. Non-cash charges added back $96.3M of depreciation and amortization and $406K of share-based compensation. Working capital and other items added $29.7M. Capital expenditures of $28.9M left free cash flow of $42.1M.
